ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:1.5 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black field originating from the peduncle and extending through the central longitudinal axis of both lobes. High-intensity white fields cover the lateral distal regions. Transition zones feature high-frequency black-on-white mottling and high-contrast linear streaks on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees, with a bounding-box depth extending significantly into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (notches) are detected, including a major irregular indentation on the mid-right lobe trailing edge and smaller jagged peaks along the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Highly convex leading edges curving toward acute fluke tips, followed by a complex concave sweep along the trailing edge leading into the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple clusters of high-contrast, circular yellow and white pixel groups (barnacles) localized along the leading edges and distal tips. Distinct grey-scale circular patches (rosettes) are visible within the black pigmentation fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of four primary dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe's white field, oriented diagonally relative to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on leading edges; notable irregular indentations on the right lobe trailing edge suggesting tissue loss; multiple high-contrast linear marks on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique yellow-hued circular bio-fouling clusters localized at the fluke tips and leading edges.
